work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
work.domainNote: Multi-cloud security, governance, and compliance software; makers of the open-source Steampipe / Powerpipe / Flowpipe / Tailpipe suite and the commercial Turbot Guardrails PSPM platform. Remote-first.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was successfully enforced against a resource; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for manual investigation and debugging.

Engineered core features for Tailpipe, a Go-based observability/SIEM CLI on DuckDB + Parquet, lifting log-processing throughput 30% to 1,000+ logs per second by chunking and batching file reads and streaming writes to DuckDB; reduced memory use to eliminate out-of-memory failures and enable incremental updates.

Authored 11 AWS log-source tables for Tailpipe in Go (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, SecurityHub, ALB/NLB/CLB/ELB access, S3 access, VPC flow, WAF, Network Firewall) and 25+ pre-built security detections; designed standardized exit-code handling, zero-data-loss DuckLake metadata backups, and a cross-platform smoke-test pipeline (CentOS, Ubuntu ARM64, macOS).
Built the Steampipe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server end to end in Python, giving LLM agents standardized, real-time access to enterprise cloud and security data for retrieval and analysis.

Designed a multi-agent workflow on the OpenAI Agents SDK to orchestrate LLM agents that generate cloud preventive-policy commands (e.g., blocking public S3 buckets by region), validate them in a live test environment, self-correct failures, and score accounts against an internal security metric.

Built a RAG-based internal Pydantic AI agent to resolve cross-team queries by ingesting the documentation and code graph for all internal repos into S3 vector storage; deployed it to AWS Lambda and integrated it with the Slack Bot API as the UI for easy developer access, resolving onboarding and cross-team queries instantly.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, Terraform-driven integration testing, and PR creation; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring Azure API throttling.

highlights.text: Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services (SecurityHub, CloudWatch, ControlTower, Shield, Comprehend, Pinpoint, RAM, X-Ray, EC2, EFS) in production Node.js Lambdas, refactoring discovery, configuration-sync, tagging, and resource-cleanup workflows; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via Nunjucks templating and shrank bundle size through modular imports, keeping the platform supported past AWS SDK v2 EOL and unblocking the Node.js runtime upgrade.
highlights.note: Reconciliation: 'call sites' = 'modules' (per user). Older versions variously say '180+ modules' / '30+ modules' for the Azure Event Grid migration and '35+' elsewhere; 180+ call sites across 11+ services and 35+ Azure modules are the values carried forward. The ~60% duplication reduction via Nunjucks templating is confirmed valid.

highlights: Authored multi-cloud compliance modules in HCL + SQL covering 1,000+ resource checks across CIS (AWS v4–v6, Azure v2.1–v4.0, GCP v3–v4, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, GitHub), NIST, HIPAA, PCI DSS v4, SOC 2, and FedRAMP frameworks — used by enterprise customers in finance, healthcare, and government — cutting enterprise compliance-audit time 50%.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements, multi-stage CTEs, and condition-aware filters — improving query performance 40% (cutting audit-report generation from 3 minutes to 1.5 minutes across 10,000+ resources) and eliminating a class of false-positive findings that were corrupting enterprise audit reports.
Automated creation of CIS markdown documents from XLSX using Python and a custom regex builder, reducing manual effort and human error and improving developer experience from weeks to seconds.

Added multi-distro Linux smoke tests (ephemeral environments) for Turbot's Go CLIs to the GitHub Actions release pipeline, hardening release safety and catching regressions across Linux distributions before deployment.

Owned release engineering for four open-source Go CLIs (Steampipe, Powerpipe, Flowpipe, Tailpipe) — unified GitHub Actions release/version workflows, automated Slack release notifications, and GHCR Docker image tagging; shipped HCL function-call support across Steampipe and Tailpipe by extending the shared pipe-fittings Go library (a top-requested feature).

Built GitHub-as-a-cloud governance controls extending Guardrails with rule builders, a scoring engine, and prevention policies for branch protection, workflow permissions, runners, dependency restrictions, MFA, and commit-author/message rules.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team to investigate pod logs and status and restore service.
